info.title: Recruify - LLM Metadata Microservice
info.description: Autonomous microservice API for the LLM Metadata domain

get.description: Service health check with DB ping.
Lists all registered LLMs along with their multi-modal capabilities.

schema.title: Response List Llms Api Llms Get

post.description: Registers a new LLM configuration with optional capability probing (Text, Audio, Vision, Tools).

get.description: Retrieves a single LLM configuration by ID.

post.description: Tests an LLM's capabilities (Text, Audio WAV, Vision Image, Tools).

put.description: Sets a specific LLM as the globally active model for all platform AI services.

get.description: Lists all registered cloud transcription / Whisper models.

schema.title: Response List Transcription Models Api Transcription Models Get

post.description: Registers a new cloud transcription model (OpenAI, Groq, OpenRouter).

get.description: Retrieves the currently active transcription model.

schema.title: Response Get Active Transcription Model Endpoint Api Transcription Models Active Get

get.description: Retrieves a single transcription model by ID.

put.description: Updates an existing transcription model configuration (API key, base URL, model identifier, etc.).
Sets a transcription model as the globally active model for speech-to-text.

post.description: Tests a transcription model against the provider's /audio/transcriptions endpoint.

get.description: Lists all registered TTS models across all providers.

schema.title: Response List Tts Models Api Tts Models Get

post.description: Registers a new TTS model configuration (OpenAI, ElevenLabs, Cartesia, Deepgram, OpenRouter, Custom).

get.description: Retrieves the currently active TTS model.

schema.title: Response Get Active Tts Model Endpoint Api Tts Models Active Get

get.description: Retrieves a single TTS model configuration by ID.

put.description: Updates an existing TTS model configuration.
Sets a TTS model as the globally active model for speech synthesis.

post.description: Tests a saved TTS model against its provider endpoint, updating test log and returning audio base64.
Stateless TTS synthesis probe to test credentials, voice, and audio generation.
Discovers available voices from provider API or catalog presets.

schema.title: Response Fetch Voices Endpoint Api Tts Models Fetch Voices Post

get.description: Retrieves available voices for an already registered TTS model.

schema.title: Response Get Model Voices Endpoint Api Tts Models  Model Id  Voices Get
